objective: Select a clean shared native Claude/Codex memory backbone that meets matched task correctness, freshness, isolation and recovery requirements with acceptable latency and complete operating cost.
verdict: Recommend Hindsight as the fit-based shared-native target. No overall or token-efficiency winner is established; ai-memory remains the canonical operational reference, agentmemory is a retrieval challenger and MemPalace is a reserve.
evidence_scope: Original published benchmark artifacts were read and their metrics checked. Historical Mac measurements remain a sanitized transcription of a dated source report. This is source review, not new memory/model execution.

architecture_review.trigger: Consequential new clean-runtime backbone decision; conflicting quality metrics, version identities and incomplete token/cost boundaries.
architecture_review.acceptance: Accepted comparison-open verdict. Do not label Hindsight, agentmemory or another challenger the final backbone winner before matched quality, native lifecycle and complete-cost acceptance.

rows.name: ai-memory
rows.observed_result: Historical native cross-client capture/query/recovery receipts. Separate author benchmark at 0ac0dcf: 470 questions, hit@5 0.823 and fractional recall@5 0.680 with 2 KB capture.
rows.token_cost_scope: Local retrieval can avoid external inference calls. Optional consolidation, reranking and synthesis add separate work; total lifecycle savings are unmeasured.
rows.acceptance_gap: Canonical accepted 2.4.1, fresh CLI probe 2.4.2, qualified trial 2.4.2 and upstream 2.5.0 source review remain distinct. Scoped 2.4.2 lifecycle/recovery and 42 upstream scope tests passed; failures retained. Native capture, production reranker comparison and complete cost remain outstanding; no 2.5.0 acceptance.

rows.name: Hindsight
rows.observed_result: Author AMB artifacts: LongMemEval 473/500 = 94.6%; LoCoMo 1417/1540 = 92.013%. Same-harness hybrid controls: 74.0% and 79.091%. Publisher attributes Hindsight 0.4.19. Publisher SDE-bench: 61 unique bug-fix tasks repeated three times per arm. Claude corrections/task 0.847 to 0.361, solved 181/183 to 183/183; Codex 1.344 to 0.470, solved 182/183 to 183/183. No-memory control, not finalist comparison.
rows.token_cost_scope: Mean retrieved answering context: 43,624.5 vs 23,221.7 tokens on LongMemEval, and 36,235.4 vs 22,156.5 on LoCoMo. This is a quality/context tradeoff; ingestion, maintenance, reflection and downstream costs are not fully measured. SDE-bench reported coding-agent cost reductions of 24.04% (Claude Sonnet 5) and 52.26% (GPT-5.4-mini) exclude Hindsight processing and hosting; no total lifecycle savings claim.
rows.acceptance_gap: Subsequent 0.10.2 no-LLM chunk backend passed restart and bank transfer in one owned profile. Full extraction/consolidation/reflection and native capture remain unrun. Published QA uses Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview/2.5 Flash Lite and omits server/extraction deployment pins; it does not qualify the current runtime. Published Docker client/plugin inputs are not completely pinned; latest harness fixes do not attest every prior run.

rows.name: agentmemory
rows.role: Strongest retained controlled REST retrieval challenger
rows.observed_result: Historical Mac full track n=470: recall_all@5 0.821 vs ai-memory reranker-off 0.570; difference +0.251, 95% CI [+0.203,+0.299], Holm p=0.0001. This is descriptive and not a new host run. Separate publisher headline is recall_any@5 95.2%.
rows.token_cost_scope: Publisher retrieval test has no answering/judge LLM. Local embedding and a short retrieved payload do not account for optional compression or the coding agent's complete usage.
rows.acceptance_gap: Current unchanged coding-life harness execution is non-comparable because synthetic session IDs bypass fixture mapping. Native ingestion/search worked; keyless default was BM25-only. Valid current-host comparison, native capture, production reranker control, full restore and complete cost/latency remain pending.

rows.name: MemPalace
rows.observed_result: Original 500-row raw artifact mean recall_any@5 0.966. Author-labelled held-out 450-row hybrid artifact: 0.984444. These artifacts do not contain recall_all@5; neither result is generated-answer accuracy.
rows.token_cost_scope: Raw retrieval benchmark avoids provider inference. That does not measure downstream answering, local compute or optional LLM reranking.
rows.acceptance_gap: Current native short-session capture, updated/deleted knowledge, scope negatives and clean-target recovery require acceptance; author-labelled held-out performance is not independent generalization proof.

rows.name: Mem0
rows.observed_result: Managed committed top-200 artifacts: LongMemEval 467/500 = 93.4%; LoCoMo 1410/1540 = 91.558%. Current documentation headlines 94.4%/92.5% do not match those committed artifacts. Artifact models are GPT-5, unlike Hindsight's AMB run.
rows.token_cost_scope: Documentation reports 6,787/6,956 retrieved tokens/query. These are managed/query-context figures, not complete self-hosted lifecycle/provider costs.
rows.acceptance_gap: Headline/artifact discrepancy remains unresolved. Managed scores do not establish OSS 2.2.1 acceptance, and native Platform plugin routes are not drop-in-compatible with the bundled OSS server.

runtime_alignment.scope: Preserve native client accounts, model routes, cache and compaction. QMD keeps document retrieval; code tools stay project-scoped. A new isolated prefix starts with unknown acceptance. No client wiring, server start or production migration was performed.

selection_gate.quality: Same dataset partition and native coding tasks; current pinned deployable profiles; same answerer/judge and retrieval budget; correctness, freshness and abstention thresholds before efficiency.
selection_gate.lifecycle: Both native clients with ordinary hook trust; isolated project/bank identities and cross-scope negatives; interruption/replay; deletion without reseeding; empty-target restore and source/target independence.
selection_gate.cost: Initial retain/seed, embedding, extraction, consolidation, page refresh, retrieval/reranking, reflection, retries and resulting coding-agent calls; separate input/output/cache-read/cache-write/storage billing scopes and cold/warm latency.
